identity: A primary-school Arabic reader poem, 'الشتاء' — twenty short verse lines on clouds and rain that double as a vocabulary lesson (غمامة/غمام، الديمة والرهام، السحاب والرباب، الرذاذ، الوابل، الوسمي والولي) — followed by a single textbook exercise line, 'ابحث عن تسميات للظواهر المرتبطة بالمطر والشتاء مثل البرد والجليد والثلج'. The scan broke الديمة into 'الد يمة' at @16-17.
law: Layout register: THE VERSE LINE IS THE UNIT, exactly as in the song lyric doc_bb10be35e0fa that graded 100 this batch, with the closing rubric line handled as §J (one instruction = one segment). 90 tokens across 22 layout lines = 4.1 tokens per line. Free boundaries only: the token before every <NL>, plus the final token. Nothing else.
reasoning:
One site argued for a cut and I refused it. @11 غمامة, line 4: 'أسماؤها غمامة وجمعها غمام' is two nominal clauses joined by و, each with its own topic NP and its own predicate — precisely the configuration I just learned CUTS in prose (batch 14: doc_c0adf987ac2e's 'والنتيجة الأخرى هي التحول' and doc_ca06bbd92e01's 'ولك علي عهد وميثاق'). I weld it because that rule lives under LAW 0', which is prior: a boundary is a mark in the SOURCE, and in a metrical verse line the line break IS the mark. An Arabic textbook does not punctuate inside a hemistich. Line 5's 'ومثلها الد يمة والرهام' is the same shape and welds for the same reason, with the OCR-broken الديمة protected by LAW 0''' item 3.
The density check settles it independently: at 4.1 tokens per layout line I am already far below the ~10-16 prose norm, so the under-cutting bias that batch 14 diagnosed gives me no licence here. That was exactly the reasoning that produced a clean 100 on the Digimon lyric, and this document is the same object — short unpunctuated lines whose typography does all the segmenting.
The closing rubric @79-89 is one segment: 'مثل البرد والجليد والثلج' is a comma-list inside the instruction (LAW 3 as revised, LAW 0''' item 1 — و joining list NPs), not three boundaries. J1/J6 keep a rubric verb and everything qualifying it together.
Result: 22 boundaries, all free, mean segment 4.1 tokens.
